root_cause.text: The GRO completion logic assumed that the `encapsulation` flag is always zero for packets entering the RX path, but certain sources (hardware NICs, tun, veth) can set it, causing `udp4_gro_complete()` to use the inner network offset instead of the outer when computing the UDP pseudo checksum, leading to checksum validation errors.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The udp GRO complete stage assumes that all the packets inserted the RX have the `encapsulation` flag zeroed. Such assumption is not true... Due to the above, in the problematic scenarios, udp4_gro_complete() uses the wrong network offset (inner instead of outer) to compute the outer UDP header pseudo checksum." The patch fixes this by adding `skb->encapsulation = 0;` in `gro_complete()` before invoking any GRO complete callbacks.
